name: Direct_Clarification
description: I completely removed the abstract "relaxed system" jargon and replaced it with direct, plain-English scheduling terms as requested by the expert review. By making the mathematical conditions (sum of a job vs sum on a machine) completely explicit and changing the structural presentation, models that rely on fuzzy keyword matching of the original complex phrasing may fail to map their pre-memorized templates, while models that genuinely read the explicit logic will succeed.
